description: Accelerate the sign-DC torch-level pipeline for shape 11 (lapdense_even512), now the dominant shape-11 cost (~60ms of ~84ms) after the reduced-block megakernel was sped up: the Newton-Schulz matrix-sign iterations, spectral-projector GEMMs, CholeskyQR2 orthonormalization, Rayleigh-Ritz, and back-transform form a fixed-topology sequence of many small batched GEMM / torch-op launches. Profile to attribute the ~60ms across launch-overhead vs compute; if launch-bound, amortize the fixed-topology launch sequence with an explicit-node CUDA graph (cudaGraphCreate/AddKernelNode/Instantiate) launched on the default NULL stream; if compute/redundant-work-bound, cut Newton-Schulz iteration count via a sharper sign polynomial, fuse the projector applies, or cheapen the back-transform GEMM. Targets launch-overhead / redundant-work; keep the residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback, route guarded per shape.

Attribution (parent nsys shape-11, 1 rep): wall 84.4ms / GPU busy 77.9ms (92.3%) / idle gap 6.5ms (7.7%) => COMPUTE-BOUND, not launch-bound. Torch-pipeline compute excl 24.5ms megakernel = 53.4ms: GEMM 24.2 / TRSM 9.5 / baddbmm 7.7 / misc-elt 5.8 / POTRF 2.9 / gather-sort 2.1. Pursued redundant-work lever: degree-5 pade sign map (15,-10,3)/8 @ 12 iters replacing degree-3 NS @ 18. MEASURED shape11 83952->121755us (+45% regression: pade5@12 under-converges in TF32 -> membership degrades -> partial cuSOLVER fallback). Other 12 shapes unchanged.

degree-5 pade @ 14 iters: shape11 126663us (WORSE than t1 pade5@12's 121755). More iters made it worse => NOT convergence-count; the degree-5 sign in TF32 fails membership/gate persistently -> cuSOLVER fallback + extra GEMM cost. TF32-precision problem in degree-5 form. Next: instrument fallback count.

mixed deg5-head(4)+deg3-tail(8), 12 total iters. SIGNDC_DBG confirms binding gate=ORTHOGONALITY: eigr identical (~0.0035) across all degrees, but orth degrades as sign convergence drops (deg3@18 orth 0.003 nbad0; deg5@14 orth 0.015 nbad17; mixed4/8 orth 0.02 nbad90). shape11 124803us (worse). Finishing-NS(1) is calibrated for deg3@18's orth 0.003; any iter cut pushes orth above its cleanup capacity. Lever = orthogonality/finishing, not eigr/sign-count.

Instrumentation trial (SIGNDC_TIME CUDA-event stage timers, degree back to 3). Per-stage sign-DC breakdown (per-call avg, sum 77.8ms==nsys busy): powerscale 1.34, ns_sign 16.27, proj_cqr 19.79 (BIGGEST torch lever), lift_build 2.08, mega_eigh 29.11 (not target), member_topk 2.31, finish_ns 5.27, rayleigh_sort 1.62. Torch pipeline around megakernel=48.7ms. #1 torch lever = CholeskyQR2 (proj_cqr 19.8ms, bigger than the sign) on stacked 2b x n x K=300 with 2 passes. shape11 84238us, geomean 27795 (deg3, no regression).

CQR2 pass-2 as NS refinement (ns_refine=1). Stage timer proves the trsm is reducible: 3_proj_cqr 19.79->11.87ms (-7.9ms). BUT orth_max 0.003->0.92 nbad 638/640 -> full fallback shape11 281490us. Projected bases P+/-@Om are RANK-DEFICIENT (K=300 > rank ~256); NS ortho diverges on near-null cols (shifted Cholesky regularizes them, NS cannot). 2nd CQR pass is doing rank-deficiency conditioning, not refinement. Need a rank-safe cheaper orthonormalizer to bank the 7.9ms.

Finishing NS in plain TF32 vs 3xTF32. Stage timer: 7_finish_ns 5.27->0.93ms (-4.3ms). BUT orth 0.003->0.010 > gate, nbad 640/640, shape11 284671us. Plain-TF32 NS step barely improves orth (~3e-4/op error ~ its own correction); raw sign-DC Q is orth ~0.010, only 3xTF32 finishing reaches 0.003. 3xTF32 finishing accuracy is load-bearing. Both cheap-orthonormalization ideas (t5 trsm-NS, t6 tf32-finish) fail on the SAME wall: reduced-precision orthonormalization can't hold the orth gate.

CQR trsm -> K x K triangular INVERSE + plain-TF32 GEMM Qc@L^-T (inv_gemm). proj_cqr 19.79->17.41ms (-2.4ms) BUT orth 0.003->0.031, nbad ~20, shape11 115456us. Forming explicit inverse of the near-rank-deficient Cholesky factor is numerically unstable vs the backward-stable trsm.

Same inv_gemm but GEMM in 3xTF32 (FP32-accurate). proj_cqr 22.81ms (SLOWER: 3 bmm + K x K inverse > direct trsm) and orth 0.059 nbad ~44 shape11 123455us. Higher GEMM precision does NOT fix it -- the instability is in the explicit inverse of the Cholesky factor, not the GEMM. Confirms the FP32 trsm is required; the ~9.5ms trsm resists cheaper substitutes (NS t5, inv-GEMM t7/t8) -- all break the orth gate.

CLEAN WIN: finishing-NS DELTA form Q<-Q-0.5Q@(G-I) with 3xTF32 Gram (accurate E=G-I) + plain-TF32 correction Q@E (E small -> TF32 abs error ~3e-6 negligible). 3 bmm vs 5. 7_finish_ns 5.27->3.38ms (-1.9ms), nbad=0/640, orth 0.004576<gate, VAL 39/39. shape11 84238->83712us (-0.6%), geomean 27795->27796. Orth margin now tight (99.96% of bound). Combinable with other wins.

Relax internal orth gate 75->90*n*eps (real reference.py ceiling=100, so 0.005493<0.006104 w/ ~10% margin) + NS 18->17 iters + delta finish. Config _SIGN_DC_ORTH_FAC/_EIGR_FAC. 2_ns_sign 16.31->15.41ms. Most nbad=0 (4/122 nbad=1, orth up to 0.0068 correctly fall back since my gate < real). shape11 83712->82652us (-1586 vs baseline), geomean 27795->27760. VAL 39/39; shape11 correctness verified by benchmark check:pass (sign-DC path only hit by benchmark shape 11). Opened the gate-headroom lever: real checker allows orth 100/eigr 200 vs internal 90/175.

Fuse 2 projector applies into one wide X@[Om|Om2] GEMM. 3_proj_cqr 19.83->20.58ms (WORSE): the 2 baddbmm already fuse the 0.5*Om add; wide GEMM+split/scale/add elementwise cost more than saved. nbad 4->9. shape11 82652->83774us, geomean 27773. Neutral/negative; reverting.

K 300->294 (safe count-wise, max_side 288.5). REGRESSION: K=300 is a CUTLASS tile sweet spot; K=294 hits worse tiling -> proj_cqr 19.83->23.62, lift_build 2.10->4.60, member_topk 2.33->4.76, mega 29.65->31.10, shape11 82652->92825us, geomean 28014. K stays 300; projector fusion (t11) also reverted. K-reduction is blocked by tile alignment, not FLOPs.

CQR1 + 2 finishing steps: proj_cqr 19.83->10.44ms (-9.4ms) BUT orth 0.73 nbad ~600/640 shape11 268141us, geomean 33112. CQR1 fuzzy bases -> wrong reduced Gram -> membership picks NEAR-DUPLICATE columns; NS can't separate duplicates. 2nd CQR pass prevents duplicate selection (structural), not just refinement. CQR2 irreducible (t5/t7/t8/t13 all confirm). Reverting next.

Revert to t10 best (CQR2/finish1) + powerscale 4->3: 1_powerscale 1.21->1.01ms (-0.2ms) BUT looser scale -> orth_max 0.0134 (1 matrix falls back), nbad 4->6, shape11 82652->83467us, geomean 27904. Net worse at the tight gate-90/17-iter point. powerscale=4 already tuned. Reverting to 4.

CONSOLIDATED BEST (delta-finish + gate90/17-iters + powerscale4). shape11 82152us (baseline 84238 = -2.5%), VAL 39/39. Two banked wins: (1) finishing-NS DELTA form 5->3 bmm (7_finish_ns 5.27->3.38ms, robust orth 0.0046); (2) internal orth gate 75->90 (real reference.py ceiling 100) + NS 18->17 (2_ns_sign 16.3->15.4ms, ~10% margin to real, safe). Other 12 shapes unchanged. Established: pipeline is COMPUTE-bound (92% GPU busy, gap 6.5ms) so no CUDA graph; binding constraint everywhere is ORTHOGONALITY; CQR2 (proj_cqr 19.8ms, the biggest torch lever) is structurally irreducible (NS-refine/inv-GEMM/CQR1 all break orth). Best commit c7cc171.

Full 3xTF32 finish vs delta at 17-iter/gate-90: same 4 fallbacks (those matrices' 17-iter sign too fuzzy for even full finish to pull under gate), but +1.9ms (finish 3.38->5.28ms), shape11 82152->84254us. Delta finish strictly better (same fallbacks, 3 vs 5 bmm). Reverting to delta.

FINAL BEST HEAD: restore delta finish. shape11 82140us (baseline 84238, -2.5%), geomean 27739 (run's best, vs parent logged 27918), VALIDATION 39/39. Config: NS 17 iters + orth gate 90*n*eps (real reference.py ceiling 100) + delta 3xTF32 finish + CQR2 + K=300 + powerscale 4. Two wins: delta-finish (5->3 bmm, robust) + gate-headroom/17-iters (uses the checker's orth headroom, ~10% margin, safe). 'stream' absent, -O3, other 12 shapes unchanged.

ATTRIBUTION (trial 1, parent nsys shape-11, 1 rep): wall 84.4ms / GPU-busy 77.9ms (92.3%) / idle-gap 6.5ms (7.8%) => COMPUTE-BOUND, not launch-bound. A CUDA graph would target only the ~6.5ms gap (mostly genuine deps), so NOT pursued. Torch-pipeline stage breakdown (CUDA-event timers, per-call avg): powerscale 1.34 / ns_sign 16.27 / proj_cqr(CholeskyQR2) 19.79 / lift_build 2.08 / mega_eigh 29.1(NOT this brief) / member_topk 2.31 / finish_ns 5.27 / rayleigh_sort 1.62. BINDING CONSTRAINT everywhere = ORTHOGONALITY (eigr always ~0.0035 vs its 0.0092 gate; orth pinned near its 0.004578 gate). 

BEST = commit 983f5cd5128cb482d7e3f8b070aaf3bf3b2fba0b: shape11 84238->82140us (-2.5%), geomean 27918->27739, 39/39 valid, stream absent, -O3. TWO banked wins: (1) finishing-NS DELTA form Q<-Q-0.5*Q@(G-I) with 3xTF32 Gram + plain-TF32 small correction (E small => TF32 abs error ~3e-6 negligible): 5->3 bmm, finish 5.27->3.38ms, robust. (2) internal orth gate 75->90*n*eps (reference.py REAL ceiling is 100) + NS 18->17 iters: uses the checker's orth headroom (~10% margin, >> the ~0.1% 3xTF32-Gram measure error, safe) to route a slightly-fuzzier sign; ns_sign 16.3->15.4ms. 

NEGATIVES (all break the orth gate -- the pipeline is calibrated at the orth edge): degree-5 pade sign (eigr fine but orth 3-6x worse in TF32); mixed deg5/deg3; CQR2-as-NS-refine (diverges on rank-deficient bases); CQR trsm->K x K inverse+GEMM (numerically unstable inverse); CQR1+finish (fuzzy bases -> DUPLICATE columns, NS can't separate); plain-TF32 finish (barely improves orth); K 300->294 (CUTLASS tile misalignment -- 300 is a sweet spot); powerscale 4->3 (less scale margin -> more fallbacks). 

STILL OPEN: (a) proj_cqr 19.8ms is the biggest torch lever but the FP32 trsm resists every cheaper substitute tried -- a rank-deficiency-safe FP32-accurate orthonormalization that avoids the wide K x n trsm would bank ~7ms; (b) the CUSTOM-KERNEL route: X in the sign iter is SYMMETRIC, a batched syrk (X@X) would ~halve the 16ms ns_sign, but torch has no batched syrk (needs a CUDA kernel, off the pure-torch scope of this brief); (c) push orth gate to 95 (0.005799, ~5% real margin) IF a follow-up wants to trade robustness for ~1 more iter cut -- riskier for the leaderboard's other seeds; (d) member_topk back-transform (Vstk=Ustk@gstk) + 2 membership GEMMs = ~2.3ms, unexamined for fusion; (e) delta-finish + gate-90/17-iter is the SAFE subset -- delta-finish ALONE (gate 75, 18 iters, orth 0.0046, 0 fallback, robust) is the most conservative win if the coordinator wants max leaderboard safety.
